paragraphs: I am applying for the Full Stack Developer role at Perfect Harvest. I was drawn to your work in designing, operating, and consulting for cannabis cultivation facilities across the country and your focus on integrating AI-driven technologies into business processes.

My core strengths are in full-stack development, with a focus on building secure, observable, and scalable software solutions using modern JavaScript frameworks and serverless architecture on Google Cloud Platform. I have extensive experience with Node.js, Firebase Functions, and various NoSQL and SQL databases.  I am proficient in using TypeScript for building robust and type-safe applications and have experience with RESTful APIs and third-party integrations.

In a previous role, I engineered a solution that consolidated diverse enterprise systems into a unified platform, automating the end-to-end workflow and reducing manual effort by over 100 hours per month.  I have also developed custom automation and tooling to analyze system behavior, identify anomalies, and harden production environments, focusing on robust system architecture, strong authentication, and disciplined monitoring and alerting.

My experience aligns perfectly with your requirements. I am comfortable owning the entire lifecycle of a solution, from design through deployment and operations, and I am confident in my ability to contribute significantly to your team's success.  I am eager to learn more about this opportunity and discuss how my skills and experience can benefit Perfect Harvest.
